text_markup: The ability of {card:Weyland Consortium: Built to Last} only causes the Corp to gain 2[c] when they advance a card that "had no advancement counters". This ability becomes pending immediately after an instruction resolves in which the Corp advances a card, and the requirement is checked against the state of the game at the previous checkpoint, before that advancement took place.
